footer: You're receiving this email because you have an EtnoJourney account.

bookingCreated.subject: We've received booking {code}
bookingCreated.heading: We've received your booking
bookingCreated.intro: Thank you for travelling with EtnoJourney. Here's a summary of your booking.
bookingCreated.next: Our team and your village hosts will check availability. You'll get another email as soon as the booking is confirmed.

pending.label: Pending
pending.explanation: Your booking is waiting for confirmation from our team and your village hosts.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.explanation: Good news, your booking is confirmed. Your hosts are getting ready to welcome you. Meeting point details are on the tour page.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.explanation: This booking has been cancelled. If you've already paid, our team will contact you about the refund.

completed.label: Completed
completed.explanation: Thank you for travelling with us. Share your experience by writing a review from your account page, so future guests and our partner villages can learn from it.

paymentSucceeded.subject: Payment for booking {code} received
paymentSucceeded.heading: Payment received
paymentSucceeded.intro: We've received your payment for {tour}. Keep this email as your receipt.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your EtnoJourney password
passwordReset.preheader: Use this link to create a new password.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset your account password. Click the button below to choose a new one.
passwordReset.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
passwordReset.expires: This link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't request a reset, you can ignore this email. Your password won't change.

admin.footer: You're receiving this email because you're on the EtnoJourney back-office team.
admin.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

bookingCreated.subject: New booking {code}: {tour}
bookingCreated.heading: New booking
bookingCreated.intro: A traveller has just booked {tour}. It is waiting for payment and confirmation.

paymentSucceeded.subject: Payment received for {code} ({amount})
paymentSucceeded.heading: Payment received
paymentSucceeded.intro: The traveller has paid for {tour}. Check the booking and let the village hosts know.

reminder.subject: Your trip to {destination} is coming up ({code})
reminder.heading: Your trip is almost here
reminder.intro: {days, plural, =0 {{tour} starts today.} =1 {{tour} starts tomorrow.} other {{tour} starts in # days.}} Here is everything you need for the day.
reminder.meet: Please arrive at the meeting point a little early. Your host will meet you there.
reminder.ticket: Your e-ticket (PDF, sign in to download):
reminder.support: Questions before you go? Contact us at {contact}.

reviewRequest.subject: How was {tour}?
reviewRequest.preheader: Share your experience in a couple of minutes.
reviewRequest.heading: How was your trip?
reviewRequest.ask: A short review helps future travellers choose well and supports the village hosts who welcomed you. It only takes a couple of minutes.
reviewRequest.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
reviewRequest.once: We only send this request once per trip.

refund.unpaid: Nothing had been paid for this booking, so there is nothing to refund.
refund.full: You'll receive a full refund of {amount}.
refund.partial: Under our cancellation policy, {percent}% of your payment comes back to you: {amount}.
refund.none: You cancelled {days, plural, =0 {on the travel date} one {# day before travel} other {# days before travel}}, so under our cancellation policy no refund applies.
refund.processing: Our team sends refunds manually to your original payment method. How long it takes to arrive depends on your bank or e-wallet; we'll let you know once it has been sent.

cancelled.subject: Booking {code} cancelled
cancelled.preheader: Your booking for {tour} has been cancelled.
cancelled.heading: Your booking is cancelled
cancelled.intro: As you requested, your booking for {tour} on {date} has been cancelled.

rescheduled.subject: Booking {code} moved to {date}
rescheduled.heading: Your new travel date
rescheduled.intro: Your booking for {tour} has been moved from {from} to {to}. The price stays as booked.
rescheduled.next: Our team will let your village hosts know. We'll send you a reminder again shortly before the new date.

cancelled.subject: Traveller cancelled {code}: {tour}
cancelled.heading: Booking cancelled by the traveller
cancelled.intro: The traveller cancelled {tour} on {date} from their account. The seats are free again.
cancelled.refundQueued: A refund is owed under the cancellation policy and is waiting in the refund queue.
cancelled.noRefund: No refund is owed for this cancellation.

rescheduled.subject: Booking {code} moved to {date}
rescheduled.heading: Booking rescheduled by the traveller
rescheduled.intro: The traveller moved {tour} from {from} to {to}. Please let the village hosts know.

manifest.subject: Manifest {tour}, {date}
manifest.heading: Departure manifest
manifest.intro: Thank you for guiding {tour} on {date}. Here is the list of guests travelling.
manifest.listHeading: Guests ({count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}}):
manifest.privacy: This guest data is for the trip only. Please do not share it with anyone else.
manifest.footer: You received this email because the EtnoJourney team assigned you as the guide.
